hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (laptop; gross numbers; provisional pending the desktop gfx1151)
change: IQ4_NL added to the dense raw-IQ integer-MMQ route. Kernel support landed and is correct; the quant is held out of the default policy on numerics.

feasibility_determination.method: The MMQ expansion contract is one float scale plus 32 signed int8 per K32 group. Tested per quant by recovering the group scale as a real GCD of the dequantized magnitudes (an earlier probe that guessed the scale as min|nonzero| was wrong: IQ4_XS's codebook has no +/-1, so it reported a false negative on a quant that demonstrably works).

results.IQ3_S: per-32 scale, integers in [-15,15] - expressible, needs its 2 KB grid table ported into the MMQ translation unit; not yet wired
results.IQ4_NL: per-32 scale, integers in [-127,127] - expressible with no new table (one K256 span is eight consecutive 18-byte blocks); implemented, held out on numerics
results.Q3_K: scale per 16 elements; under a per-32 scale the residual integers reach +/-128 and do not fit int8 - blocked
results.IQ2_S: scale per 16 elements; residual integers reach +/-1333 - blocked
results.IQ2_XS: scale per 16 elements; residual integers reach +/-1333 - blocked

kernel_correctness.leaf: scripts/gguf_iq_dense_mmq_crossover.py with CROSSOVER_QUANT=IQ4_NL: max relative error 0.0052-0.0072, correlation 0.999983 against the strict GEMV across all measured shapes and row counts

numerics_blocker.protocol: context512, 18 prompts x 9 forced steps, production config, independent tokenwise llama.cpp teacher
numerics_blocker.why_held_out: That mean is the worst of any default measured, and the cost is concentrated rather than diffuse: median per-position delta is exactly 0.000000 and p90 is +0.000925, while a few positions diverge 100-300x (prompt 4 step 2: 0.000225 -> 0.022335; step 3: 0.000061 -> 0.019991; prompt 10 step 1: 0.000028 -> 0.008484). 89 of 162 positions worsen at all. This is the signature of a small number of sensitive tensors, not general precision loss, so the route is held until they are identified.

limitations: The sensitive tensors were not localized in this unit; only 7 IQ4_NL tensors exist in K_M (0.33 GB) across attn_qkv/ffn_down/ffn_gate/ffn_up, so a role- or layer-level exclusion is likely tractable.
gfx1100 declares no dense MMQ policy at all and is unaffected.
